topic: Reporting on-time rent to build credit vs paying rent that never counts (Marcus vs Willa)

scenes.narration: You can pay rent perfectly for years and build absolutely zero credit. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room pointing at a blank credit report, comic burst banner reads RENT CREDIT CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marcus and Willa both rent apartments and pay on time.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel in a doctor's office of man marcus and woman willa each handing over a rent check stamped ON TIME, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Landlords usually never report those rent payments to credit bureaus.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a chart of a rent check with an arrow crossed out toward CREDIT BUREAU, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marcus assumes steady rent alone is building his credit history.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, confident man marcus beside a report card labeled MY CREDIT that is blank, exam room background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His credit file stays thin with almost no track record.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man marcus holding a nearly empty folder stamped THIN FILE in a doctor's office, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Willa enrolls in a rent-reporting service that notifies the bureaus.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman willa tapping a phone app labeled RENT REPORTING sending to CREDIT BUREAUS, exam room desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Now each on-time rent payment lands on her credit report.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman willa watching a rent check drop onto a report labeled CREDIT REPORT, doctor's office background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Modern scoring models like VantageScore can factor that rental history.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a chart labeled VANTAGESCORE counting RENT HISTORY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marcus applies for a loan with a nearly blank file.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man marcus at a loan desk holding an empty folder stamped NO HISTORY, exam room setting, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Willa now shows many months of positive payment history instead.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, smiling woman willa holding a full report labeled POSITIVE HISTORY in a doctor's office, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same rent checks, but only one of them built credit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man marcus with a blank report and woman willa with a full report labeled CREDIT BUILT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: If your file is thin, report on-time rent to the bureaus. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a clipboard reading REPORT YOUR RENT, comic burst banner reads STAY HEALTHY, kids comic book illustration
